errors.evidence: The description lists the category as "Неизпълнение на пазара" (Non-performance of the market), but the actual label on the chart is "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара" (Disruption of competition / market).

The description incorrectly combines two separate categories from the chart, "Неизправност на продукта" (Product malfunction) and "Етично нарушение" (Ethical violation), into a single non-existent category "Етично нарушение на продукта" (Ethical violation of the product).

The description incorrectly identifies a category as "Интегриране на работното място" (Integration of the workplace), whereas the actual label on the chart is "Интегриране на продукта" (Product integration).
The description incorrectly states that the bars are arranged in random order, when they are clearly sorted in descending order of value.

The description omits several categories present in the chart, including "Неизправност" (Malfunction), "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара" (Disruption of competition / market), "Неизправност на продукта" (Product malfunction), and "Действия на акционера" (Shareholder actions), while misreading or conflating others.
The value for the bar corresponding to the "Други" (Other) category is approximately 5%, not 6%.

The description states that the lowest bar belongs to the "Други" (Other) category, which is an oversimplification. There are four categories with a similar lowest value of approximately 5%: "Действия на акционера", "Хуманитарно", "Тероризъм", and "Други".
The description uses a slightly incorrect label "Финансов/ликвиден" for the category "Финансови / ликвидност".
